Application Data.NAME: GreenFairway Sports Supply
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: GreenFairway Sports Supply specializes in the retail of golf and sporting equipment, including golf clubs, balls, apparel, and accessories. The store aims to provide high-quality products for golf enthusiasts and athletes, catering to both beginners and professionals. In addition to retail sales, we offer equipment rentals and personalized fitting services to enhance customer experience on and off the course. Our knowledgeable staff is dedicated to helping customers find the right gear to improve their game and promote an active lifestyle.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, minor water damage occurred due to a leaky roof, resulting in repair costs of $1,200. Status: Closed. On 03/10/2023, a theft incident was reported where sporting goods worth $3,800 were stolen. Status: Open, pending investigation by local authorities.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Chain-link fencing and 24/7 security watchpersons for theft prevention.
